messages:
amira: @channel Quick update: SDK v4.1 releases next Wednesday. Two policy changes: (1) client telemetry becomes opt-in by default, and (2) the old ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json is replaced by a per-process --runtime-config option. Full migration guide: https://go.redwood/docs/sdk-v4-1-migration
noah: Will this disrupt hosted customers or only those using the flags file?
jen: Mostly the latter. Hosted server telemetry remains unchanged. Client-side telemetry (the small env/usage pings) will be disabled unless explicitly enabled. The SDK will accept the legacy file for a 30-day grace period after GA but will emit a deprecation warning to stderr.
ops: Action item for Dedicated/Private: if your fleets mount the runtime file via config-management, switch to mounting a JSON at REDWOOD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH or pass --runtime-config. We added a console tool to translate common keys.
docs-bot: I opened PR #4212 with CLI examples, helm snippets, and a short FAQ. Please proof the snippets especially for mobile and on-prem steps.
cs-team: We need a customer-ready blurb + an FAQ for CSMs. Which customers will be flagged as impacted?
amira: I'll produce the blurb and a list of potentially impacted Dedicated/Private customers tomorrow morning. Comms cadence: day 0 announcement, day 2 targeted email, day 7 GA + console banner, day 14 reminder.
release-bot: Artifact built: v4.1.0-rc4 (sha: c9d8e7f). Integration tests queued.
noah: DevEx: please make the telemetry opt-in visible in quickstarts and sdk init templates.
jen: Snippets to add to docs: Node: const c=new Client({telemetry:{enabled:true}}); Python: export REDWOOD_SDK_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN=true; CLI runtime: --runtime-config='{"enable_fast_kv":true}'.
amira: Thanks team. If migration-check jobs show failures, @ops and @jen please escalate to me immediately. :thumbsup:
